definitions.explanation: A pencil with a colored wax or pigment core, used for drawing, coloring, and marking. Usually sold in sets of various colors.

examples.english: Draw a picture with colored pencils.

examples.japanese: {二十四色|にじゅうよんしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a 24-color colored pencil set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}→塗り絵：28879_nurie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き→売れ行き：14897_ureyuki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Adult coloring books have become popular, and sales of high-end colored pencils are growing too.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color) + ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧ (pencil). Counted with the counter {本|ほん}: ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧ "one pencil."
